observations.regular: DesignSettingsRow uses a flexible leading label column, Space.lg trailing separation, and a trailing accessory without moving label content.
observations.accessibilitySize: DesignSettingsRow switches to a leading VStack and keeps the accessory trailing in a separate 44pt-capable row.
observations.labelControlSemantics: The row uses accessibilityElement(children: .contain), so its label/detail remain exposed while native accessory labels, values, actions, and bindings remain owned by the control.
observations.dynamicType: Row text uses Typo UI roles and relative SwiftUI text styles; label content is allowed to wrap rather than truncate.
observations.rtl: The implementation uses SwiftUI stacks and leading alignment; no physical left/right offsets or direction-specific fixture branches were added.
observations.localization: Title and detail remain caller-provided strings; no source copy is transformed or hard-coded in production.
observations.reducedMotion: The row adds no motion. Existing segmented/toggle/range controls retain their own accessibilityReduceMotion handling.
observations.contrast: Dusk semantic ink roles are used; row details and canonical toggle/select row details use ink2 for supporting text.
observations.targets: The row content measure is 56pt and all existing native control owners retain their 44pt minimum target rules.
observations.nativeSelect: Closed and selected values use the reachable SwiftUI Menu owner. The approved custom open listbox is documented as a native adaptation, not reproduced.
observations.nativeRange: The reachable DesignSlider owner is retained; its native track/value composition differs from the desktop trailing-range reference and remains documented in the final diff.
observations.hoverFocusPressed: iPhone hover is not applicable. Static focus/pressed states are not fabricated; native controls retain live interaction behavior outside static capture.
